findings.statement: Native S62 reader opcode0x62 0x579020 parses two u8, BEu16, three u8, four string8, u8, BEu16, u8; native S63 opcode0x63 reader0x585950 parses two u8. Consumers 0x4F2CD0 and 0x4F2F10 add/remove ActionEntry and clear shortcuts.

evidence.locator: 0x578F89 ctor; 0x579020..0x5790DC reader; 0x4F2CD0 ActionEntry call; 0x5858B9 ctor; 0x585950 S63 reader; 0x4F2F10 consumer

limitations: No original Server snapshot order or learned-skill names established.

findings.statement: ActionInventory key is kind*80+slot, not cast_value. S62 first BEu16 stores ActionEntry+0x04. Another BEu16 after four strings stores ActionEntry+0x80E and becomes C4D wire BEu16 when nonzero.
limitations: Official stable skill ID and presentation-word semantics remain unknown.

findings.statement: Native shortcut per-row has 10 cells, stride12, valid DWORD/type DWORD/slot byte. It reads and writes Shortcut.row.cell.IsValid/Type/Slot settings; raw shortcut Type0..3 is translated before ActionInventory lookup.
limitations: Actual settings path, account isolation and cross-device sync unknown; Shortcut.Type not directly equal S62.kind.

findings.statement: Entry+4 has a UI consumer at 0x444AFB and resource index lists Icon.dat skill.ypf and spell.ypf, but precise official icon frame/skill_id mapping is unproven; original Icon.dat not uploaded.
limitations: No known Skill*.dat / Spell*.dat official definition selector.

findings.statement: After authorized character selection/World entry, Server should publish character-owned S62 snapshot before shortcut use; preserve kind/slot across logins; S62 update/S63 removal only after authoritative learned-action state change; C4D must be validated against learned catalog, not trusted.

evidence.locator: S62 creates row, S63 removes row; C4D from ActionEntry+0x80E

limitations: Original login packet order, learn action opcode and Server cooldown/MP/range are unproven.
